title: Pride of the Prairies
description: A western-inspired orchestral ride through untamed landscapes where wild horses roam freely across vast plains.
seo_title: Pride of the Prairies | Expedition Creativity
story: Inspired by the Western plains on which wild horses roam freely, Pride of the Prairies combines rhythmic percussion, melodic violin motifs and whistling solo trumpets into a cinematic orchestral journey through untamed landscapes.
